chunks: Ja'far ibn Muhammad ibn Ibrahim al-Musawi narrated to me from Abdullah [Ubaidullah] ibn Nahik, from Sa'd ibn Salih, from al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Abi al-Mughirah, from one of our companions, who said:

I said to Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), 'I am a man with many illnesses and diseases, and I have not left any medicine without having treated myself with it.' He said to me, 'Why are you not using the dust of al-Husayn (peace be upon him)? Verily, in it is the cure for every disease and safety from every fear.'

And say when you take it: 'O Allah, I ask You by the right of this clay, and by the right of the angel who took it, and by the right of the Prophet who gathered it, and by the right of the Successor who lies in it. Send blessings upon Muhammad and his family, and make for me in it a cure from every disease and safety from every fear.'
He said, then he said: 'Verily, the angel who took it was Gabriel, and he showed it to the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) and said,

I said, 'I have understood the cure for every disease, but how is it a safety from every fear?' He said, 'If you fear a ruler or something similar, do not leave your house except that you have with you some of the clay of the grave of al-Husayn (peace be upon him), and in it is the cure and the safety.'

And say when you take it: 'O Allah, verily this is the clay of the grave of al-Husayn, Your Wali and the son of Your Wali. I have taken it as a protection for what I fear and for what I do not fear, for indeed what you do not fear may befall you.'

The man said: 'So I took it as he said, and by Allah my body became healthy, and it was for me a safety from everything I feared and everything I did not fear, as he said. So I did not see anything disliked by the grace of Allah after it.'

key_terms.تُرْبَةُ الْحُسَيْنِ: The dust/clay from the grave of Imam al-Husayn

ai.seo_question: What is the spiritual and physical benefit of using the clay from the grave of Imam al-Husayn (a.s.) according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith from *Kamil al-Ziyarat* highlights the Shia concept of *turbat al-Husayn* as a spiritual and physical remedy, linking the Prophet Muhammad, Angel Gabriel, and Imam al-Husayn in a unique metaphysical chain of custody for the clay. The Imam’s detailed explanation of the supplication’s components underscores the intercessory role of the Ahl al-Bayt, while the companion’s testimony validates its efficacy for both known and unknown fears. This narrative reinforces the theological significance of the martyrdom of al-Husayn as a source of divine protection (*hiz*) and healing (*shifa*) in Shia devotional practice.

en.sayyid-mohsen-al-husayni-al-milani: 10. Ja’far ibn Muḥammad ibn Ibrāhīm Al-Mūsawi narrated to me from ‘Abdillāh ibn Nahīk, from Sa’d ibn Sāliḥ, from Ḥasan ibn ‘Ali ibn Abī Mughīrah, from one of our companions, who said:

I said to Abī ‘Abdillāh (Imam Sādiq (a.s.)), “I am a man with many illnesses and diseases and there is not any medicine that I have not tried.” Imam (a.s.) said: Why have you not used the dust (from the grave) of Ḥusain (a.s.)?! Verily it contains the cure for every disease and it is protection against any fear.

When you take from it you should say:                                    O Allāh! I ask You through the right of this clay, through the right of the angel who took from it, through the right of the Prophet who held it, and through the right of the Successor who is lying in it to send Your blessing on Muḥammad and his family and to make it my cure against every disease and my protection against any fear.

Then Imam (a.s.) added: The angel who took from it was Jabra`īl who showed it to the Prophet (s.a.a.w.) and said, “This is the dust of this son of yours. Your nation will kill him after you.” The prophet who held it was Muḥammad (s.a.a.w.) and the successor who is lying in it is Ḥusain ibn ‘Ali (a.s.), the Master of the Martyrs.

I said, “I understand that it is a cure for every disease but how is it a protection against any fear?” Imam (a.s.) replied: If you fear a ruler or anything similar to that, do not leave your house without carrying some of the clay of the grave of Ḥusain (a.s.).

When you take from it, you should say:                 O Allāh! This is the clay of the grave of Ḥusain, Your Walī and the son of Your Walī, and I have carried it as protection against that which I fear and that which I do not. Imam (a.s.) added, “Verily it is possible that a tragedy which you do not fear might befall you.”

So I took it as he had ordered and I swear to Allāh that I became healthy. It was also my protection against that which I feared and against that which I did not fear, just as the Imam (a.s.) had said. Praise be to Allāh that I have not seen any misfortune ever since.
